name: What steps are involved in building a custom shower from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in building a custom shower from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with demolition down to the subfloor and wall framing to inspect for hidden water leaks. Next, any framing adjustments are completed to accommodate niche boxes, benches, or new door hardware, followed by rough plumbing for valves and drains. After plumbing inspections, moisture-resistant drywall or cement backer board is hung, and a complete waterproofing membrane is applied to the walls and shower pan. Once waterproof testing passes, tile or marble is installed and grouted. The project concludes with finish plumbing trim, fixture installation, and custom glass door mounting.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes demolition, plumbing rough-ins, framing adjustments, waterproofing, tile and grout installation, and final fixture and glass trim installation.
